value.name: Marcus leads Elena upstairs
value.description: Marcus guides Elena up the lighthouse's iron spiral staircase toward the upper level.
evidence: Marcus leads Elena up the iron spiral staircase.

value.name: Elena notices locked door
value.description: At the top landing, Elena pauses when she sees a closed door secured with a heavy padlock.
evidence: At the top landing, below the lantern room, a narrow corridor has two doors.
The other door is CLOSED and secured with a heavy padlock.

value.name: Elena asks about locked room
value.description: Elena questions Marcus about what is inside the locked room.
evidence:
ELENA
What's in the locked one?

value.name: Marcus dismisses Elena's interest
value.description: Marcus says the room contains old coast guard material and tells Elena it is irrelevant to her story.
evidence:
MARCUS
(not stopping)
Old coast guard material. Nothing that concerns your story.

value.name: Marcus refuses Elena access
value.description: When Elena starts to ask for access, Marcus cuts her off with a firm refusal.

value.name: Elena studies locked door
value.description: As Marcus continues upward, Elena lingers behind and examines the locked door.
evidence: He continues up toward the lantern.
Elena lingers at the locked door, studying it.

value.name: Elena descends to entrance hall
value.description: Elena leaves the upper floor and goes down to the lighthouse's main entrance hall.
evidence: Then she descends to the entrance hall.

value.name: Elena discovers silver key
value.description: At the base of the staircase, Elena notices a small old silver key hanging beside the main entrance door.
evidence: Elena pauses at the base of the staircase.
There, mounted on the wall right beside the MAIN ENTRANCE DOOR, hangs a SILVER KEY on a simple iron hook.

value.name: Elena documents key location
value.description: Elena photographs the silver key and writes a note in her notebook recording where it hangs.
evidence: She photographs it with her phone and opens her green spiral notebook.

ELENA
(writing quietly)
Silver key. Hook beside the main door.
